limitations.finding: A 20-page cap was used; stored terminal flags lack the raw response cursor chain needed to independently verify completion.
limitations.required_replacement: Capture each wire cursor input/output and the actual null terminal response without a page-count cap.

limitations.finding: All three UI/direct detail timing pairs are numerically identical and have no independent request timestamps; independent measurement is not established. Equal timings alone do not establish fabrication.
limitations.required_replacement: Capture independent UI resource and direct-request start/end timestamps and request IDs.

limitations.finding: First/subsequent request labels do not establish cold/warm OS or database cache conditions.
limitations.required_replacement: Keep production observations separate from controlled isolated cold/warm runs.
